THE PHOTO MATTERS

Clear rules build trust.

In this prototype, photos stay inside the open browser tab and are not uploaded. Before launch, the live service must state exactly where photos go, how long they are kept and how parents can delete them.

One separate, front-facing photo is needed for each person in the story.
